cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.last_updated: Last updated: November 2026. This policy explains what cookies are, how they are used, and how you can control them.

what_are_cookies.title: 1. What are cookies?
what_are_cookies.content: Cookies and similar storage technologies (such as localStorage) are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They allow the website to remember user actions and preferences over a period of time.

used_cookies.title: 2. Cookies used on this site
used_cookies.intro: This portfolio only uses two categories of data storage:
used_cookies.essential_description: We use browser localStorage to remember your dark/light theme preference and your cookie consent decision. These do not track personal information and are strictly necessary for the site to function as expected.
used_cookies.analytics_description: With your consent, we use Firebase Analytics (Google Analytics for Firebase) to collect anonymized data on page views, device types, and visitor navigation. This helps understand which content is most relevant and improve site performance.

ga.purpose: Distinguishes unique anonymous sessions and users for site analytics

manage_consent.title: 4. Manage your consent
manage_consent.description: You can change or revoke your cookie preferences at any time. When you click the button below, the consent banner will reappear, allowing you to update your choice:

browser_control.title: 5. Browser control
browser_control.description: You can also prevent cookies from being placed on your browser by adjusting your browser settings (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, etc.). Note that disabling essential local storage may affect the dark mode persistence on the website.
